title: Aberdeen亚太权益资产主管：印度盈利上修，外资回流时机已到？
speaker: Pukesai

segments.en: Yes, so I think, and again, back to the earning season as we are in the midst of it, but as we go through the earnings of our Indian companies, I think what's standing out quite clear this time, which we have not seen for many quarters actually, is the positive earnings revisions and growth that is starting to come off India after a very long period of a tough times as India went through some of its macro challenges and inflation, et cetera, et cetera.
segments.zh: 是的，回到财报季，我们在审视印度公司财报时，这次明显看到盈利上修和增长，这是多个季度以来首次，此前印度经历了较长时间的宏观挑战和通胀压力。

segments.en: So this time, I think the key change is that we are seeing a change in fundamentals and earnings is really starting to come back.
segments.zh: 这次的关键变化是基本面改善，盈利真的开始回升。

segments.en: And therefore, we do think that as foreigners have gone out of India for quite a fair bit, it is a good time to be adding back and picking up the quality stocks that we like.
segments.zh: 因此，鉴于外资此前大量流出印度，我们认为现在是重新加仓、挑选优质标的的好时机。

segments.en: You might ask us what are the stocks that we like. Starting with the financials, it is a good place to play.
segments.zh: 你可能会问我们看好哪些方向。首先金融板块是一个不错的切入点。

segments.en: The valuation remains relatively attractive. It has gone through a deal rating as well. Yes, it's going to be more expensive than Chinese banks, but growth is also going to be higher.
segments.zh: 估值仍相对有吸引力，也经历了估值重估。虽然比中国内地的银行贵，但增长也更高。
